message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code fetches articles from remote URLs via the search pipeline and Article.from_html, but there is no checksum verification, signed URL validation, pinned commit, or source authentication performed on the retrieved content.

No detected label flipping detection: The code uses label2id/id2label mappings and a label_set but never validates incoming claim labels against the expected set or checks for label distribution anomalies before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code applies basic length and content checks (e.g., content < 32 chars, duplicate URL/content filtering) for deduplication purposes, but there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or poisoning-specific defenses on the training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The model is loaded via `SequenceClassificationModel.from_pretrained(pretrained_model_name_or_path)` with no hash check, signature verification, pinned revision, or controlled-source enforcement.

No detected label distribution validation: The code uses stratified train/test splitting which preserves distribution but does not explicitly validate or check label distribution or class balance before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no evidence of any backdoor or trigger detection mechanism such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the visible code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of hashed/signed evaluation data, a strictly isolated held-out test set enforced at evaluation time, or multiple independent metrics used to guard against manipulation; the train_test_split utility exists in datasets.py but there is no isolation enforcement or integrity check at

No detected output bounds checks: The _sequence_classification function returns raw probabilities from prediction_output.predictions with no NaN checks, range validation, or threshold guards on the model outputs.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a sequence classification model (not an LLM), and no prompt-injection filtering, system-prompt isolation, or jailbreak detection is present anywhere in the visible code.
